note: Banco Popular's agreement for its Visa Cash Rewards card covers residents of Puerto Rico: no annual fee, and a purchase APR from 16.99% to 29.99% by creditworthiness, the Prime Rate plus a margin, written at the top of its range. The six months at 1.99% are introductory.

sources.title: Banco Popular de Puerto Rico, Credit Card Agreement for Visa Cash Rewards
sources.said: After that, your APR will be from 16.99% up to 29.99%, based on your creditworthiness. ... Annual Fee $0 Annual Fee ... For unsecured Accounts if you reside in Puerto Rico or the US Virgin Islands, the margin applicable to your Transaction types will depend on your credit worthiness ... For Secured Accounts, Popular Inc. or any of its subsidiaries’ employees and for residents of the British Virgin Islands, the APR applicable to your Transaction types will be determined by adding the Prime Rate at the time of approval of your application to a margin.
